items.html: And behold, since the essence of the Shema is for the nursing of the internality, therefore the third pregnancy of the Mochin of Katnut is included in it, as well as the first pregnancy of the three included in three of the internality. And only the nursing of the internality was mentioned, which is the Mochin of VAK, hinted at in the word 'Echad', as is known. But, indeed, there are three couplings, as above, and all of them are called either the aspect of the third pregnancy of the externality, because it comes first in the intentions of the Shema, as mentioned, or the aspect of Gadlut, the pregnancy of the internality.
